name: Isekai Lovers! ~Kyonyuu no Yuusha-tachi wa Choro-in~
original_name: イセカイ・ラヴァーズ！ ～巨乳の勇者達はちょろいん～
source:
Isamu was a heavily-devoted FPS player who hated fantasy stories. He got a call-up notice as a reward for placing first in the world, but when he arrived at the designated gathering spot, he was brought to another world. The knight Rina, magician Kachua and elf Aida stood before him in a world that looked like a fantasy game. Kachua had summoned a hero to fight the monsters and save the world, but it seemed like he was useless. However, he was able to defeat them using a handgun which had been summoned with him, by striking at the vital points using his limited knowledge of fantasy games. He was treated as a hero and joined the girls on their journey. Maybe fantasy games aren’t so bad after all!

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/09/01/september-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
勇是一名狂热的FPS玩家，讨厌幻想故事。他因获得世界第一名而收到征召通知，但抵达指定集合地点后，却被带到了异世界。在这个宛如幻想游戏的世界里，骑士莉娜、魔法师卡秋娅和精灵艾达站在他面前。卡秋娅召唤英雄来对抗怪物、拯救世界，但勇似乎毫无用处。然而，他用随自己一同被召唤来的手枪，凭借有限的幻想游戏知识瞄准要害，成功击败怪物。他被当作英雄，加入女孩们的旅程。也许幻想游戏也没那么糟！

[译自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/09/01/september-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
